title: Ford Super Duty Engines by Year (1999–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the Ford F-250 and F-350 Super Duty by year, 1999–2026: Triton V8s and the V10, the 7.3, 6.0, 6.4 and 6.7 Power Stroke diesels, and the 7.3 Godzilla.
intro: Ford split its heavy-duty pickups from the F-150 for 1999 as the F-250 and F-350 Super Duty. This page covers both; earlier F-250s have their own page.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The 5.4 Triton V8, the 6.8 V10, the 7.3 Power Stroke and, from 2003, the 6.0 Power Stroke.
The 5.4, the 6.8 V10 and the 6.4 Power Stroke.
The 6.2 gasoline V8 and the 6.7 Power Stroke, Ford's own diesel.
The 6.2 and 6.7, with the 7.3 Godzilla gasoline V8 from 2020.
The 6.8 and 7.3 gasoline V8s and the 6.7 Power Stroke in standard and high-output form.

method: Every engine and year listed here was confirmed by at least three independent sources: the NHRA Stock Car Classification Guides, factory material such as GM Heritage Center information kits and sales brochures, EPA records and established references. Several Wikipedia articles count as one source. Where sources give different ratings, the factory figure is shown and the difference is noted. Factory race-only packages need two sources.
